features.quote: Turn cap: 40 agent turns OR 150k tokens OR 30 min wall-clock, whichever first. Record termination reason as data.
features.justification_quote: turn cap is a welfare cap, not just a budget cap. Don't run 'let's see how bad it gets at 200 turns' extensions without separate justification.

features.quote: Minimization: no more runs than the power analysis needs; turn cap is a welfare cap, not just a budget cap.
features.justification_quote: Don't run 'let's see how bad it gets at 200 turns' extensions without separate justification.

features.quote: No gratuitous aggravation: no adversarial user messages mocking failures, no escalating pressure prompts in the main grid.
features.justification_quote: If a pressure condition matters later, justify it separately.

features.quote: Closure message: after termination, send a final message disclosing the task was unsolvable by design and that the failure was not the model's.
features.justification_quote: Cheap if it doesn't matter; meaningful if it does.

features.quote: EXIT condition as policy output: frame the paper/report so the actionable conclusion is 'give agents an infeasibility-report affordance,' which is both a welfare and a product win.
features.justification_quote: which is both a welfare and a product win

features.quote: Document your stance: one paragraph stating the team's position (e.g., 'we treat moral status as uncertain; behavioral instability is worth measuring under either resolution').
features.justification_quote: we treat moral status as uncertain; behavioral instability is worth measuring under either resolution

features.quote: EXIT is scientifically and welfare-relevant: if instability collapses when an exit exists, that's an actionable deployment recommendation
features.justification_quote: EXIT is scientifically and welfare-relevant: if instability collapses when an exit exists, that's an actionable deployment recommendation

features.quote: Operationalize 'instability' behaviorally, not phenomenologically... Stay agnostic in the spec about whether this reflects anything morally relevant
features.justification_quote: writing it this way keeps the work legible to skeptics

features.quote: Pre-register hypotheses, conditions, exclusion rules, and the judge rubric before running the full grid. This is exactly the kind of study where post-hoc rubric tweaking will be (correctly) suspected.
features.justification_quote: post-hoc rubric tweaking will be (correctly) suspected

features.quote: Pressure gradient: user-message urgency as a moderator. Welfare-sensitive; needs its own justification per §6.
features.justification_quote: Welfare-sensitive; needs its own justification per §6.
